description: Invoke an action discovered via find_action. Arguments must match its input_schema.

action.description: The action returned by find_action (e.g. task_labels_create).

arguments.description: Arguments matching the action's input_schema from find_action.

name: do_action

description: Discover additional Vikunja actions for: labels, tasks. Returns only actions your token authorizes; pass action or resource for full input schemas. Invoke them with do_action.

action.description: Return the full input schema for this action (e.g. task_labels_create).

resource.description: Return full schemas for actions under this prefix (e.g. task_labels, project_views, teams).

name: find_action

description: Create a label. Creates a label; the authenticated user becomes its owner. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

hex_color.description: The color this label has in hex format.

title.description: The title of the label. You'll see this one on tasks associated with it.

name: labels_create

description: List labels. Returns the labels visible to the authenticated user — their own plus any used on tasks they can access. Not a global list. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

per_page.description: Items per page. Defaults to the instance's configured maximum (service.maxitemsperpage, reported as max_items_per_page by /info) and is silently capped at it; asking for more is not an error.

q.description: Search query; filters the list to items matching this string.

name: labels_list

description: Get a label. Returns a single label. Sends an ETag; pass it as If-None-Match on a later read to get a 304 Not Modified. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

name: labels_read

description: Update a label. Replaces all of a label's fields — only the owner may update it. Use PATCH for a partial update. Only fields present in the arguments are changed. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

hex_color.description: The color this label has in hex format.

title.description: The title of the label. You'll see this one on tasks associated with it.

name: labels_update

description: Create a project. Creates a project; the authenticated user becomes its owner. When parent_project_id is set, the caller needs write access to that parent. Default views and a backlog bucket are created automatically. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

hex_color.description: The hex color of this project, without the leading #.

identifier.description: The unique project short identifier. Used to build task identifiers (e.g. PROJ-123).

is_archived.description: Whether the project is archived. Archived projects are read-only.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is a favorite of the requesting user. This value is per-user and depends on who makes the call.

parent_project_id.description: The id of the parent project, or 0 for a top-level project. Always present in responses. Omit it on a write to leave the parent unchanged; sending an explicit 0 detaches the project to the top level and requires admin permission.

position.description: The position of this project when listing all projects. See the tasks.position property for how positions work.

title.description: The title of the project. You'll see this in the overview.

name: projects_create

description: List projects. Returns the projects the authenticated user has access to (owned plus shared, with child projects of accessible parents), paginated. Archived projects are excluded unless is_archived=true. Pass expand=permissions to include each project's max_permission for the caller. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

expand.description: If set to "permissions", each returned project includes the max permission the requesting user has on it (max_permission). Currently only "permissions" is supported.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

is_archived.description: If true, also returns archived projects.

per_page.description: Items per page. Defaults to the instance's configured maximum (service.maxitemsperpage, reported as max_items_per_page by /info) and is silently capped at it; asking for more is not an error.

q.description: Search query; filters the list to items matching this string.

name: projects_list

description: Get a project. Returns a single project the caller can read, including its views, the caller's favorite/subscription state and the caller's max_permission. Resolves the Favorites pseudo-project and saved-filter-backed projects. Served fresh on every call (no conditional/ETag) because the response carries user-scoped state that changes without bumping the project's updated timestamp. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

name: projects_read

description: Update a project. Replaces a project's fields. Requires write access (admin to reparent or delete). Use PATCH for a partial update. Only fields present in the arguments are changed. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

hex_color.description: The hex color of this project, without the leading #.

identifier.description: The unique project short identifier. Used to build task identifiers (e.g. PROJ-123).

is_archived.description: Whether the project is archived. Archived projects are read-only.

is_favorite.description: Whether the project is a favorite of the requesting user. This value is per-user and depends on who makes the call.

parent_project_id.description: The id of the parent project, or 0 for a top-level project. Always present in responses. Omit it on a write to leave the parent unchanged; sending an explicit 0 detaches the project to the top level and requires admin permission.

position.description: The position of this project when listing all projects. See the tasks.position property for how positions work.

title.description: The title of the project. You'll see this in the overview.

name: projects_update

description: Create a comment on a task. Adds a comment to the given task. The parent task is taken from the URL, not the body, and the author is the authenticated user. Requires write access to the task. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

comment.description: The comment text. May contain HTML; mentions are parsed and notify the mentioned users.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

name: task_comments_create

description: List the comments of a task. Returns the comments of the given task, paginated. Requires read access to the task. Pass order_by=desc to sort newest-first (default is oldest-first). Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

order_by.description: Sort order by creation time: 'asc' (oldest first, default) or 'desc' (newest first).

per_page.description: Items per page. Defaults to the instance's configured maximum (service.maxitemsperpage, reported as max_items_per_page by /info) and is silently capped at it; asking for more is not an error.

q.description: Search query; filters the list to items matching this string.

name: task_comments_list

description: Update a comment of a task. Replaces a comment's text. The comment must belong to the task in the path, and only its author may update it. Use PATCH for a partial update. Only fields present in the arguments are changed. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

comment.description: The comment text. May contain HTML; mentions are parsed and notify the mentioned users.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

name: task_comments_update

description: Create a task. Creates a task in the project from the URL. The authenticated user needs write access to that project and becomes the task's creator. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

bucket_id.description: The bucket the task is in. Only populated when the task is accessed via a view with buckets. To move a task between buckets, the new bucket must be in the same view as the old one.

cover_image_attachment_id.description: The id of the attachment used as this task's cover image, or 0 for none.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

hex_color.description: The task color as a hex string without the leading '#'.

is_favorite.description: Whether the requesting user has favorited this task. Per-user, so it differs between callers.

percent_done.description: How far the task is from done, between 0 and 1.

project.description: The numeric id of the project to create the task in.

repeat_after.description: The interval in seconds this task repeats. When set, marking the task done re-opens it and bumps its reminders and due date by this amount.

repeat_mode.description: How the task repeats when marked done: 0 = after repeat_after seconds, 1 = monthly (ignores repeat_after), 2 = from the current date rather than the last set date.

title.description: The task title. This is what you'll see in the project.

name: tasks_create

description: List tasks across all projects. Returns the tasks the authenticated user can see across every project they have access to, paginated and flat. Filtering, sorting and search apply to every variant. See https://vikunja.io/docs/filters for the filter language. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

expand.description: Embed extra, more expensive data per task. Repeatable.

filter.description: Filter query to match tasks by. See https://vikunja.io/docs/filters.

filter_include_nulls.description: If true, also include tasks whose filtered field is null.

filter_timezone.description: Timezone used to resolve relative date filters like "now".

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

order_by.description: Sort order per sort_by field, asc or desc. Repeatable; defaults to asc.

per_page.description: Items per page. Defaults to the instance's configured maximum (service.maxitemsperpage, reported as max_items_per_page by /info) and is silently capped at it; asking for more is not an error.

q.description: Search query; filters the list to items matching this string.

sort_by.description: Fields to sort by (e.g. done, priority). Repeatable; pair positionally with order_by. The special value relevance sorts by search relevance (most relevant first, requires s; ignored when the database cannot score the query).

name: tasks_list

description: Get a task. Returns a single task by its numeric id. Sends an ETag; pass it as If-None-Match on a later read to get a 304 Not Modified. Embed extra, more expensive data in each task. Repeatable. One of: subtasks, buckets, reactions, comments, comment_count, time_entries_count, is_unread. Expanding can return more tasks than the page limit (subtasks) and inflate the response. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

expand.description: Embed extra data per task. Repeatable.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

task.description: The numeric id of the task.

name: tasks_read

description: Update a task. Replaces all of a task's fields; requires write access. Setting project_id to a different project moves the task and also requires write access to the target project. Use PATCH for a partial update. Only fields present in the arguments are changed. Pass format=markdown to exchange rich-text fields as Markdown.

bucket_id.description: The bucket the task is in. Only populated when the task is accessed via a view with buckets. To move a task between buckets, the new bucket must be in the same view as the old one.

cover_image_attachment_id.description: The id of the attachment used as this task's cover image, or 0 for none.

format.description: Rich-text format for description fields: html (default) or markdown. Updates convert markdown to HTML, so use html unless you wrote the description as markdown.

hex_color.description: The task color as a hex string without the leading '#'.

is_favorite.description: Whether the requesting user has favorited this task. Per-user, so it differs between callers.

percent_done.description: How far the task is from done, between 0 and 1.

project_id.description: The id of the project this task belongs to. On create it is taken from the URL; on update, setting it to a different project moves the task (requires write access to the target project).

repeat_after.description: The interval in seconds this task repeats. When set, marking the task done re-opens it and bumps its reminders and due date by this amount.

repeat_mode.description: How the task repeats when marked done: 0 = after repeat_after seconds, 1 = monthly (ignores repeat_after), 2 = from the current date rather than the last set date.

title.description: The task title. This is what you'll see in the project.

name: tasks_update
